selected_primary: Recreate and improve the original source Figure 4 guide-versus-non-targeting-control discrimination endpoint: complete guide-by-donor-by-fold AUROC outputs for Plexus and manual features in WT WTC11 and WT Patient strata, under the original source well-split and preprocessing protocol. separately_preserved_biological_scope: Separately retained biological reproduction: the broader CRISPRi phenotypic and network-level gene-modifier findings and their source-defined controls. The previous 52-gene/four-line registration and prospective whole-plate extension remain historical, not implied coverage of the selected Figure 4 endpoint. Improved guide discrimination does not establish new biological gene discoveries.
